descriptions.text: The Bolt of Ophiotaurus. This is 1 of 100. This item acts as a regular crossbow bolt unless it is shot directly into the eye of a deity. Upon a successful strike to the god's eye, the deity's invulnerability pauses for fifteen seconds.

recap.text: Katia receives a single crossbow bolt in a benefactor box from Princess Formidable. The bolt pauses a deity's invulnerability for fifteen seconds if it hits an eye. Carl decides the sender, the dead sister of Crown Prince Stalwart and the Maestro, is not a fan of her brother. Carl tells Katia the gift was a message rather than a plan to kill the Maestro.

Katia gives a crawler a bolt that he sticks into a goddess's eye. He blows himself up, the explosion severs her neck, and the system marks him for death by every deity except her enemies. Katia retrieves the bolt from her inventory and tells Carl it is reusable if it does not break.

Donut swaps into a room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps with a Scorpion's Bite mount on her back. She fires Katia's bolt into Emberus's smouldering eye socket and a Danforth bolt into the other eye. Taranis twists his wrist with one second left and Emberus explodes.

beats.headline: One of a hundred, in a benefactor box
beats.text: Katia's first benefactor box from Princess Formidable holds a single small item, and nobody says anything while she examines it. A crossbow bolt, just the one. It is a regular bolt unless it goes directly into the eye of a deity, in which case the god's invulnerability pauses for fifteen seconds. The sender is the youngest sister of the Maestro, now dead, and of Crown Prince Stalwart, who is somewhere in the dungeon. Carl reads the description and decides the sister is not a huge fan of her big brother.
beats.gist: Katia receives a single crossbow bolt from Princess Formidable that pauses a deity's invulnerability for fifteen seconds.

beats.headline: A message, not a plan
beats.text: In the trainyard, Grull, with the Maestro at the controls, told Carl mid-rampage that even the magical bolt his sister wasted on Carl's friend would not work: Carl was not strong enough yet to hurt him. Afterwards, loading the portal cart onto the employee track, Katia wishes she could have used it. Carl says it would have been a waste, since they could not have hurt him, and that the gift was probably more a message to the brother than a plan to kill him. He promises her a use for it.
beats.gist: Grull tells Carl a magical bolt cannot hurt him; Carl tells Katia it was a message.

beats.headline: Into a goddess's eye
beats.text: Ysalte stands in the corpse of Sister Ines, summoned for a boss event and invulnerable on this floor. Donut's all-caps report tells the rest. Katia gave a crawler an arrow thing, and he stuck it into the goddess's eye. Then he blew himself up, the explosion concentrated on her neck, and her head fell off. The system message names him as her slayer, marked for death by every deity except her sworn enemies. He was her own totem.
beats.gist: A crawler sticks an arrow thing into a goddess's eye and blows himself up.

beats.headline: Reusable, if unbroken
beats.text: Carl thinks Katia should have had the credit for the goddess, since it took her bolt to do it. Katia is glad she did not: every god is angry at the one who did. Then she pulls it out of her inventory. Funny thing about magical bolts, she says: as long as they don't break, you can reuse them. Carl grins back. The princess meant it for her brother inside Grull, and that possibility is still on the table.
beats.gist: Katia pulls a reusable Bolt of Ophiotaurus from her inventory to use on the princess's brother.

beats.headline: Emberus, fifteen seconds
beats.text: Donut swaps into the room through one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps with the Scorpion's Bite mount on her back, cocked and loaded with Katia's bolt. She fires true, straight into Emberus's smouldering eye socket. A second shot, one of her Danforth bolts, takes the other eye and holds him in place. The yellow glow winks off: fifteen seconds, and he cannot move. Taranis, seeing his little brother rise, raises a hand and twists his wrist, and with one second left Emberus explodes.
beats.gist: Donut fires Katia's bolt into Emberus's smouldering eye socket and a Danforth bolt into the other.
